steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Paper 2 of OCR J271 GCSE Law covers Law in Action — it is worth 80 marks and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes | Key Fact: Paper 2 Section A covers the Law of Tort: negligence, occupiers' liability, nuisance and remedies | Key Fact: Paper 2 Section B covers two options from: Law of Contract, Consumer Protection, Company Law, Employment Law, Intellectual Property and Data Protection | Key Fact: Alternatively, Section B may cover Rights and Responsibilities and Criminal Law in Context depending on the school's chosen options
